title: Efficacy of Oral Melatonin Versus Oral Olanzapine in Improving Sleep in Cancer Patients with Insomnia: Prospective Comparative Study.
quote: This prospective, double-blind, randomized comparative trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of oral melatonin (3 mg/day) versus oral olanzapine (5 mg/day) in 60 advanced cancer patients with insomnia over four weeks.
note: The record compares melatonin with olanzapine, not placebo, and the population is cancer-related insomnia.

title: Efficacy of Chronotherapeutic Combination for Major Depressive Episode With Insomnia
